title: [review] project-LICHEN-worker6-z22y: unused plaintext_3 in rfc9529_signature_trace_vectors
description:
Commit 8623e97ff421 fixed the transcript_4 function to use ciphertext_3 instead of plaintext_3 (correct per EDHOC RFC 9528 §4.5: TH_4 = H(TH_3, CIPHERTEXT_3)). However, the plaintext_3 variable at line 2125 in the rfc9529_signature_trace_vectors test is now unused, triggering #[warn(unused_variables)]. This should be removed.

File: rust/lichen-oscore/src/edhoc.rs
Line 2125-2127: let plaintext_3 = hex!(...)
Fixed by: removing the dead plaintext_3 declaration.
